calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key AND d.calendar_date >= s.valid_from AND d.calendar_date <= s.valid_to
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key AND d.calendar_date >= p.valid_from AND d.calendar_date <= p.valid_to
WHERE s.store_id = 102
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key AND d.calendar_date >= s.valid_from AND d.calendar_date <= s.valid_to
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key AND d.calendar_date >= p.valid_from AND d.calendar_date <= p.valid_to
WHERE s.store_id = 102
  AND s.store_id != 999
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
